steps.do: Search for a specific class in the built CSS file
Count occurrences of the class in the output
Extract the line containing the class definition

K-015138.example: Running `grep -o 'text-red-500' /tmp/out.css` finds the class string. The command `grep -c 'text-red-500' /tmp/out.css` returns `1` indicating it appears once in the minified CSS.
K-015138.check: The command `grep -c 'text-red-500' /tmp/out.css` outputs `1` or a positive integer, confirming the utility class was generated.
traps: Searching for the class name in source files instead of the built CSS output.
Using `grep` with the `-r` flag on the build directory which may contain source maps or node_modules.
Assuming the class is present if the source file uses it, without verifying the build output.
